_comment: POL-04 per-chunk bundle budgets in GZIP bytes (baseline + ~10-15% headroom, 2026-06-14). 'messages' is per-locale: the largest single locale catalog must fit, NOT the sum (the en/et/ru catalogs are alternates, only one loads at a time). All others sum same-prefix files. A budgeted chunk with no matching dist file counts as 0 bytes (lazy chunks can legitimately be absent).
_main_rebaselined: 2026-07-29: 215000 -> 238000. The 2026-06-14 baseline was set at v3.0 close and its headroom was consumed by real shipped features (Rapid Capture, location photos, short-code resolution, the offline queue helper), not by a regression: main measured 216196 on 2026-07-27 and 216260 today, so lint-frontend had been red on ~0.6% overshoot. Re-baselined to today's 216260 plus the same ~10% headroom the other chunks carry. NOTE this raises the ceiling without anyone having examined what is IN the main chunk — if it is breached again, audit composition for something that should be lazy before raising it a second time.
